ROYAL WESTERN INDIA TURF CLUB, LTD.

PUNE MEETING 2022, SPECIAL RACE DAY, SUNDAY, 6TH NOVEMBER, 2022.

 

  

 (PENETROMETER: 4.2 (LONGCHAMP METHOD); GOING: GOOD)

 

RACE DAY REPORTS

 

RAILS WERE PLACED AT IT'S ORIGINAL POSITION. RAILS WERE PLACED 6 METERS WIDE IN THE CHUTE.

 

On a request from Trainer S. S. Attaollahi, permission was granted to Trainer P. Shroff to saddle his charge TERESITA in the 4th race & KALAMITSI in the 7th race, at his own (Trainer S. S. Attaollahi’s) risk and responsibility.

 

On a request from Trainer Dallas Todywalla, permission was granted to Trainer Nirad Karanjawala to saddle his charge TWELFTH EARL in the 3rd race, RAFFAELLO in the 4th race, FASHION ICON in the 6th race & CHAMPERS ON ICE in the 9th race, at his own (Trainer Dallas Todywalla’s) risk and responsibility.

RACE NO.1(131) – THE B. PRAKASH TROPHY: (About) 1200 Metres – Runners -  12

 

WAYIN (App. Haridas Gore, dr.8) planted in the stall taking no practical part in the race. Trainer Rehanullah Khan has been asked show his charge in a mock race to the satisfaction of the Starter, before next accepting to race.

 

At the start, EXCELLENT GOLD (J. Chinoy, dr.10) jumped outwards onto BUCKLEY (Dashrath Singh, dr.11).

 

Soon after the start, MOZELLE (App. P. Shinde) shifted in and made contact with DESERT FIRE (Antony Raj S.).

 

Approaching the 1000 metres, DALI SWIRL (Bhawani Singh) shifted in thereby bumping and inconveniencing DESERT FIRE (Antony Raj S.). Jockey Bhawani has been cautioned.

 

Passing the 800 metres, DESERT FIRE (Antony Raj S.) leaned inwards at the same time AGOSTINO CARRACCI (K. Nazil) shifted in thereby bumping and tightening QUEEN O’WAR (N. S. Parmar) causing the latter to be checked. In view of the same Jockey’s Antony Raj S. & K. Nazil have been cautioned.

 

Passing the 400 metres, AGOSTINO CARRACCI (K. Nazili) shifted out under urging and brushed the haunches of BUCKLEY (Dashrath Singh) causing the latter to leaned inwards thereby bumping and inconveniencing DALI SWIRL (Bhawani Singh). Jockey K. Nazil has been fined Rs.5,000/-.

 

After the race, MOZELLE was found to be sore by the right fore, the filly was sent to the Equine hospital for endoscopy and no abnormality was detected. The filly has to be passed fit by the Club’s V.O., before next accepting to race.

 

After the race, NORTHERN SINGER was found to have Tongue injury.

 

After the race, BUCKLEY was trotted and found to be sound.

 

The Equine hospital reported that TOMORROWS DREAMS had injuries in both eyes.

 

RACE NO.2(132) – THE MID-DAY TROPHY: (About) 1200 Metres – Runners -  14

 

On the arrival at the start at the request of Jockey Prashant P. Dhebe, C’EST L’AMOUR was examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. who certified her fit to race.

 

On the arrival at the start at the request of Jockey Vishal N. Bunde, SMART CHOICE was examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. and found to be breathing heavily and making noise, as such, was certified unfit to race and was withdrawn on veterinary grounds before coming under Starter’s order.

 

Subsequently having sampled, the mare was scoped and was found to have laryngeal abnormality, As such, Trainer Vijay Kasbekar has been asked to take remedial measures, before next accepting to race.

 

Approaching the 600 metres, C’EST L’AMOUR (Prashant P. Dhebe) racing on the haunches of AME (N. S. Parmar) was held up for room and had to be steadied. After the race, Jockey Prashant P. Dhebe reported that he was denied a clear passage in the straight.

 

In the final stages of the race, COUNT THE WINS (S. Mosin) leaned inwards and made contact with AME (N. S. Parmar).

 

After the race, LUMINOSITY was observed to have broken a blood vessel and is not to race for the stipulated ban period of four weeks. The gelding has to be passed fit by the Club’s V.O., before next accepting to race.

 

After the race, COUNT THE WINS found to be sore by the right fore. The gelding has to be passed fit by the Club’s V.O., before next accepting to race.

 

After the race, C’EST L’AMOUR was trotted and found to be sound.

 

RACE NO.3(133) – THE FREE PRESS JOURNAL TROPHY: (About) 2000 Metres – Runners -  15

 

At the request of Trainer Subhag Singh, ANGELS TRUMPET was examined in the stable area at 12.15 p.m. on 05/11/2022 and was found to have swelling on left fetlock, the filly was certified unfit to race and was withdrawn on Veterinary grounds and has to be passed fit by the Club’s V.O., before next accepting to race.

 

Whilst Jockey Prashant P. Dhebe (BRAZOS) had weighed out with the registered racing colors. However, he had misplaced the cap, as such, he was permitted the use of the emergency racing colors i.e. All Black. In view of the lapse on his part, he has been fined Rs.1,000/-.

 

On arrival at the start at the request of Jockey S. J. Sunil (WILLY WONKAA) the surcingle of his mount was tried to be adjusted but since there was no scope to further tightened, the said equipment was replaced with the Club’s gear.

 

DALASAN (D. R. Shubham, dr.12) planted in the stall. Trainer S. Waheed has been asked to give his charge more gate practice and show the gelding in a mock race to the satisfaction of the Starter, before next accepting to race.

 

GIVERNY (N. B. Kuldeep, dr.9) stopped galloping after the start taking no practical part in the race. Trainer Subhag Singh has been asked to give his charge more gate practice and show the filly in a mock race to the satisfaction of the Stipendiary Stewards, before next accepting to race.

 

Jockey Bhawani Singh (GALLOPING GLORY) was observed to have used the whip in excess of the prescribed limit on his mount. After the race on questioning he stated that his mount hung-in in the straight and he had used the whip as corrective measures as the same was borne out from the video of the race, as such no action has been initiated against Jockey. However, Trainer Vinesh has been asked to take remedial measures, before next accepting to race.

 

After the race, BRAZOS found to be sore by the right fore. The gelding has to be passed fit by the Club’s V.O., before next accepting to race.

 

After the race, ROYAL CASTLE found to be sore by the right fore. The gelding has to be passed fit by the Club’s V.O., before next accepting to race.

 

The Equine hospital reported that COME BACK PLEASE had injury in left eye.

 

RACE NO.4(134) – THE FOURTH ESTATE CUP: (About) 1600 Metres –Runners- 10

 

Soon after the start, ARABIAN PHOENIX (K. Nazil) shifted out thereby tightening MULTISTARRER (S. Saqlain) causing the latter to clip and stumbled resulting in dislodging its rider. In view of the incident the matter has been reported to the Stewards of the Club for such action as they deem fit.

 

Soon after the start, COUNT OF SAVOY (App. Kirtish Bhagat) shifted in thereby tightening and inconveniencing FLYING SCOTSMAN (Neeraj Rawal). App. Kirtish Bhagat has been cautioned.

 

In the final stages of the race, FLYING SCOTSMAN (Neeraj Rawal) was observed to have leaned in under pressure.

 

After the race, TERESITA was trotted and found to be sound.

 

The Equine hospital reported that PRESIDENTIAL had injury in right eye.

 

RACE NO.5(135) – THE PUNE CANTONMENT BOARD CUP  - DIVISION II: (About) 1400 Metres – Runners -  10

 

MY NAME IS TRINITY (Amyn Merchant, dr.6) jumped out slowly and did not raise an effective gallop thereby losing considerable grounds at the start. Trainer Sangramsinh N. Joshi has been asked to give his charge more gate practice and show the gelding to the satisfaction of the Starter, before next accepting to race.

 

Approaching the 1000 metres, HOUSE OF LORDS (C. S. Jodha) leaned inwards onto BABA (Bhawani Singh) who had to be steadied. Jockey C. S. Jodha has been cautioned.

 

Approaching the 400 metres, BABA (Bhawani Singh) shifted out under urgings and thereby carried RENAISSANCE ART (Vikram Jodha) outwards. Jockey Bhawani Singh has been cautioned.

 

The Sr. V.O. reported that KIRKINES was declared to run with bandages but ran without bandages  on both fore. As such, Trainer Imtiaz A. Sait has been fined Rs.1,000/- for the lapse.

 

After the race, BOMBAY was trotted and found to be sound.

 

The Equine hospital reported that SILVER STEPS had injury in left eye with sore.

 

RACE NO.6(136) – THE PUNE CANTONMENT BOARD CUP  - DIVISION I: (About) 1400 Metres – Runners - 10

 

At the start, DUFY (Amyn Merchant, dr.6) jumped inwards onto HUNAR (Vishal N. Bunde, dr.5) who inturn shifted in and made contact with PRINCE IGOR (N. B. Kuldeep).

 

In the final stages of the race, ZIP ALONG (J. Chinoy) was observed to have shifted out under urgings. Jockey J. Chinoy has been cautioned.

 

RACE NO.7(137) – THE GENERAL RAJENDRASINHJI MILLION: (About) 1600 Metres – Runners -  4

 

Approaching the 200 metres, MOJITO (N. S. Parmar) shifted out despite the riders efforts thereby inconveniencing KALAMITSI (P. S. Chouhan) & COEUR DE LION (P. Trevor). Trainer A. M. Jadhav has been asked to take remedial measures, before next accepting to race.

 

After the race, MOJITO & COEUR DE LION were trotted and found to be sound.

 

RACE NO.8(138) – THE K. RAGHUNATH PLATE  - DIVISION II: (About) 1000 Metres – Runners -  12

 

Passing the 700 metres, EXECUTIVE DECISION (Vikram Jodha) shifted in and made contact with MIRAE (App. Mustakim Alam) causing the latter to be checked. After the race on questioning Jockey Vikram Jodha stated that his mount lugged in despite his efforts and had behaved in the similar manner in his last start. In view of the behavior Trainer S K Sunderji has been asked to show his charge in a mock race to the satisfaction of the Stipendiary Stewards before next accepting to race.

 

After the race, IAMSTORM was trotted and found to be sound.

 

RACE NO.9(139) – THE K. RAGHUNATH PLATE  - DIVISION I: (About) 1000 Metres – Runners -  12

 

At the start, LIGHTNING BLAZE (Prashant P. Dhebe, dr.1) jumped outwards thereby bumping and tightening DOWSABEL (K. Nazil, dr.2) causing the latter to be checked

 

Approaching the 500 metres, IMPERMANENCE (App. S. Saba) leaned inwards thereby bumping and tightening ARACANA (App. Kirtish Bhagat). App. S. Saba has been cautioned.

 

After the race, Jockey R. Ajinkya (MIDSUMMER STAR) reported that his mount shied away from the other runners and thereafter was running out in the straight despite his efforts. Trainer S. K. Sunderji has been asked to take remedial measures, before next accepting to race.

 

After the race, MIDSUMMER STAR was trotted at the stables and found to be sound but was observed to have a cut injury on left fore cannon.

 

The Equine hospital reported that HELA had injury in right eye.

 

The Equine hospital reported that SKY HAWK had injury in both eyes with right eye sore and DOWSABEL had injury in right eye with sore.

 

******************

The urine samples of the winner of the 1st, 4th & 7th race, viz. MAJESTIC WARRIOR, COUNT OF SAVOY & MOJITO, and the special samples of LUMINOSITY & SMART CHOICE (2nd race), were collected for detection of prohibited substance.

ADDITIONAL REPORT:

 

RE: ENQUIRY INTO THE RUNNING AND RIDING OF “DIVINE THOUGHTS” (DRAWN 3) IN RACE NO.97 – THE OCTOBER HANDICAP DIVISION I – RUN ON SUNDAY, 9TH OCTOBER 2022:

 

The Stipendiary Stewards reported that the saddle used on DIVINE THOUGHTS had shifted forward during the race and in view of the same they had initiated an enquiry.

 

In connection with the above on being questioned Trainer Altaf Hussain stated, that his instructions were to take a good jump go to the front and to do his best in the straight. On being asked about the saddle having shifted forward, Trainer Altaf Hussain pointed out that the Apprentice had gone to the front and thereafter leaned backwards also, the saddle had a wide frame and because of the apprentices riding position the saddle may have shifted.

 

App S. Saqlain on being questioned stated that his instructions were to go to the front and if someone is chasing then to sit 2ndto a specific question he stated that the saddle belonged to Jockey Prashant P. Dhebe and he had used it for the first time. It was pointed out to him that when the horse was inspected immediately after the race the saddle was in its proper position he explained that soon after the jump the saddle had shifted forward and at the time of pulling up after the race the saddle had moved back to its position. The race was viewed at which time Apprentice S. Saqlain pointed out that the saddle had slipped forward approaching the 1000 metres. due which he was constantly looking down and even in the straight he had looked down.

Having viewed the race and heard the submissions made by both Trainer and the Apprentice Jockey the Stipendiary Stewards were of the view that there is no doubt that the saddle had shifted forward during the race, the fact the frame of the saddle was wider than usual at the pommel may have been one of the reasons for the saddle to shift forward. Hence, reported the matter to the Stewards of the Club.

The Stewards of the Club at their meeting held on 6th November 2022 having viewed the race in question and heard the submissions made by Trainer Altaf Hussain and keeping all the circumstances in mind decided to give the benefit of doubt to Trainer and Jockey, however, they were cautioned to be more careful in the future.

 

XXXXX

 

RE: ENQUIRY INTO THE RIDING OF JOCKEY N. S. PARMAR ON “POWER OF BLESSINGS” (DRAWN 9) IN RACE NO.100 – THE RAO SAHEB KEDARI GOLD TROPHY – RUN ON SUNDAY, 9TH OCTOBER 2022:

 

The Stipendiary Stewards reported that considering Trainer Sangramsinh N. Joshi was not happy with the riding of Jockey N. S. Parmar they had initiated an enquiry.

 

On being questioned Trainer Sangramsinh N. Joshi stated that he had instructed Jockey to take a good jump and sit in the mid bunch anywhere 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th because the field is big and if he feels the horse is  sluggish at the start give him a chance to come on and improve around the bend and do his best. On being asked about his observation of the race he pointed out  that turning for home the gelding was in a good position and after the race the rider had reported to him that the gelding was flat and was going nowhere he added that when he had questioned jockey N.S.Parmar as to how he could say that the horse was flat without making an effort to ride out Jockey N.S.Parmar had  replied that due to the kick back, he could not see anything.

 

The race in question was viewed and on questioning jockey N.S.Parmar having confirmed the instructions and stated that he could not see anything due to the kick back and further requested to watch the rider of MARLBORO MAN (R. Ajinkya) who was wiping his goggles, and also requested to see this horse’s previous race when Jockey N. Nadeem rode him.

.

After viewing the race in questioned and previous runs of the horse Jockey was informed that he should have made little more effort considering where he was placed rather than dropping back behind the front horse and then having to deal with the kick back. Trainer S.N.Joshi stated that whilst others were pushing he was only sitting there.

Having viewed the race and heard the submissions made by both trainer and jockey and keeping in mind that the trainer was not happy with jockey N.S.Parmars efforts the Stipendiary Stewards reported the matter to the Stewards of the Club.

The Stewards of the Club at their meeting held on 6th November 2022 having viewed the race in question and heard the submissions made by both Trainer and Jockey and keeping all the circumstances in mind decided to give the benefit of doubt to Jockey N. S. Parmar, however, he was cautioned and asked to be more careful in the future.
